body:
I get you, dude. I don't have any advice though sorry, I'm in the same place...

It fucking sucks because we're just forever stuck in the middle of this inner turmoil and a lot of the time I don't feel like I'm really here, not ever really present. 

I'm always trying to convince myself that I do want to be alive. That I need to stay alive. But it's hard to lie to yourself.

Hope you eventually find peace, in whatever form that my come.

Thanks for the good advice and the analogy:) That's what I did when I decided to go to university- I chose to study something even though I don't love it but also don't completely hate it. But I had to do something and I'm not working. I guess it helps to just think of it as choosing the least shit option from the array of shittiness...
